About Us

Local catering, wherever the event takes us.

South Burnett Mobile Catering is a mobile food business bringing crowd favourites to events throughout the South Burnett and surrounding areas.

Whether you're organising a community event, school fundraiser, birthday, sporting day or private function, we'd love to be part of it.
